subject: Vendr onboarding: webhook-driven evidence cadence & delegated steward plan
messages:
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr portal onboarding + webhook for evidence updates

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for agreeing to help us get our Vendr profile live. We want to avoid a manual monthly push if possible: our security ops team can push evidence to an SFTP but would prefer to trigger uploads via a webhook when artifacts change.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood accept webhook-driven evidence events into Vendr (or a proxy S3) so we can do incremental CAIQ/ SIG uploads?
- Is there a way for you to delegate ownership to our internal steward so they can rotate keys / upload without repeated access requests?

Attaching a small manifest and our preliminary CAIQ-SIG map for reference.

Thanks — Jordan
Security Program Manager, Acme Analytics
[Attachment: vendr_upload_manifest.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: caiaq-sig_mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding + webhook for evidence updates

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask and the files. Short answer: yes, we can support a webhook-driven workflow into Vendr with a small intermediary job on our side to validate and surface artifacts. Proposed approach:

1) Evidence webhook -> Redwood proxy (validates producer, schema)
2) Proxy writes to a tenant-bucket (S3) and posts a manifest to Vendr via API
3) Delegated steward role: we create a scoped "vendor-steward" account for Acme that can upload / rotate temp creds through our console; full account rotation remains with Redwood for audit reasons

Action items:
- Jonas: can you sketch the proxy auth flow and TTL for presigned uploads?
- Marissa: please include this customer in the quarterly evidence rotation plan and confirm retention SLA mapping for CAIQ fragments.
- Jordan: can your security ops share an example webhook payload and confirm SFTP fallback (if webhooks fail) by EOD?

I'll draft a short playbook covering delegated stewarding and the webhook contract; attaching a first pass.

— Mina
Sr. Security Partner, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: delegation_playbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding + webhook for evidence updates

Quick tech notes / proposal:

- Auth: webhook signed with a rotating HMAC key per Acme tenant. Requests accepted only from their IP CIDR (+ optional mTLS).
- Proxy: small lambda job that validates manifest checksum, checks schema against "caiaq-sig_mapping.xlsx" rules, then writes to tenant S3 prefix. Presigned URLs expire in 15m by default; we can bump to 1h for larger artifacts.
- Delegation: create "vendr-steward" role scoped in Redwood Console with these capabilities: upload, list, request-temp-credentials. Rotation still logged in our KMS; we surface rotation events to Acme via webhook if they want.

I'll put a one-page sequence diagram into the shared doc and add sample payloads. Two clarifying questions for Mina / Marissa: 1) retention TTL for evidence (90d / 1yr / 3yr?) and 2) should we enable auto-archive to a cold bucket after 180d?

-Jonas

From: Jordan Matthews <jordan@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, security@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding + webhook for evidence updates

Mina / Jonas —

This plan looks good. For retention, Acme policy is CAIQ artifacts kept 2 years, SIG evidence 3 years; auto-archive at 180 days is fine as long as retrieval is < 48 hours.

I'll have our ops team send a sample webhook payload and rotate a test HMAC before EOD tomorrow. We'll expect the delegated steward account invite and the playbook link so our owner can test uploads.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Jordan
Security Program Manager, Acme Analytics
